sentences.en: I finally found my way out of the confusing maze.
sentences.zh: 我终于从那个令人困惑的迷宫中找到了出路。

sentences.en: I explained it to him, only to make him confused.
sentences.zh: 我把情况给他解释清楚了，结果却让他更加糊涂了。

sentences.en: They confused the names of the sender and the addressee.
sentences.zh: 他们把发件人和收件人的名字搞混了。

senses.zh: 使困窘,使混乱,使困惑,使更难于理解vi.使糊涂
